CustomField.description: Admin-tunable threshold for Shared_IP_Warning__c on Application__c. When Shared_IP_User_Count_30Day__c meets or exceeds this value, the fraud alert Flow sets Shared_IP_Warning__c = true. Monitoring/review guidance only - never used to auto-block. Exact usage is determined by the fraud alert Flow, not hardcoded in Apex.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Admin-tunable threshold: Shared_IP_User_Count_30Day__c at or above this value triggers Shared_IP_Warning__c. Monitoring only - never auto-blocks.
CustomField.label: Shared IP Count Warning Threshold
